card.name: Linking words in animal study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'from', 'in' or 'pregnant' in animal toxicity study text, right before the animal group (pregnant rats, control rats, monkeys). Also fires on a few punctuation marks after a name or phrase.

modes.label: Dosing animals
modes.description: 'to' or 'pregnant' after 'administration of [drug]' just before the test animal species.
modes.example: In an animal reproduction study, intravenous administration of margetuximab-cmkb<< to>> pregnant cynomolgus monkeys

modes.label: Comparison with controls
modes.description: 'from' or 'in' after a comparison word, just before 'control' animals.
modes.example: appeared to contain less sperm than smears<< from>> control mat

modes.label: Punctuation after a name
modes.description: A bracket or comma after an organization, publisher or diluent name.
modes.example: The contents of one vial (300 mg) should be dissolved in 3 mL of Sterile Water for Injection<<,>> USP at 22° -
